response.sql: SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_ram) AS avg_ram_of_avgs, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_of_avgs FROM (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) AS avg_ram, AVG(CAST(sp.procgpu AS REAL) / sp.proccpu) AS avg_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb > 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) subquery GROUP BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: "Pass a 60.8 GB threshold" means memusagegb > 60.8 (strictly greater than, not ≥).
procgpu and proccpu values are non-zero to avoid division by zero errors.

alternatives.interpretation: "Pass a threshold" could be interpreted as >= (meet-or-exceed) rather than > (exceed).
